hints.content:
###Amount the watch normally costs

The watch that normally costs $w$ dollars.

###Percent decrease of the discount, as a decimal

Chad used a $30\%$ discount. We can rewrite $30\%$ as a decimal as $0.3$.

###Amount of the discount

The discount is $30\%$ of the normal price of the watch.

So the amount of the discount is $30\%\cdot w$, which is equivalent to $0.3w$.

###Percent of the normal cost that Chad paid, as a decimal

Chad paid $100\%-30\%=70\%$ of the normal price of the watch. We can rewrite $70\%$ as $0.7$.

Situation | Expression
:- | :-:
Amount the watch normally costs | $w$
Amount of the discount | $0.3w$
Percent decrease of the discount, as a decimal | $0.3$
Percent of the normal cost that Chad paid, as a decimal | $0.7$

question.content:
Chad bought a watch that normally costs $w$ dollars. He used a $30\%$ discount.

The expression $0.7w$ describes the amount of money Chad paid for the watch. We can also use the expression $w-0.3w$ to represent the same quantity.

**Match each amount in the situation with the expression that represents it.**

Percent of the normal cost that Chad paid, as a decimal
